answer.answer: PMKVY Recognition of Prior Learning certifies industry-relevant skills for candidates who already possess prior-learning experience or skills [E01]. The other pathway from the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship that serves candidates seeking fresh short-term skills training is PMKVY 4.0 - Short-Term Training, which provides free NSQF-aligned skill training ranging between 300 and 600 hours to youth looking for fresh skilling, re-skilling, or upskilling [E03].

claim_to_evidence.claim: PMKVY Recognition of Prior Learning certifies industry-relevant skills for candidates with prior-learning experience or skills
PMKVY 4.0 - Short-Term Training serves candidates seeking fresh short-term skills training and provides free NSQF-aligned skill training ranging between 300 and 600 hours
